Gardner-Johnson was ejected late in the second quarter for unsportsmanlike conduct following an exchange with a group of Raiders players, including tight end Brock Bowers. In issuing the suspension, the NFL cited its rule applying to "any act which is contrary to the generally understood principles of sportsmanship". messages.text: Ronaldo punished over Portugal walkout with fine he can pay off in 39 seconds

metadata.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo has been suspended for 30 days and fined £215 over his walkout from the Portugal national team following an explosive fallout with head coach Jorge Jesus.
metadata.content: Cristiano Ronaldo: Portugal captain punished over walkout following explosive row with head coach Jorge Jesus | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Cristiano Ronaldo: Portugal captain punished over walkout following explosive row with head coach Jorge Jesus Portugal captain Cristiano Ronaldo claimed head coach Jorge Jesus twice broke his word about the star's role in the team after he walked out on the national team's camp on the eve of a match; he has now been punished for his actions but will not miss any Portugal matches Monday 19 October 2026 20:37, UK Image: Cristiano Ronaldo has made 234 appearances for Portugal Cristiano Ronaldo has been suspended for 30 days and fined £215 over his walkout from the Portugal national team following an explosive fallout with head coach Jorge Jesus. The Portuguese FA's disciplinary council did not specify when Ronaldo's ban begins, but Sky Sports News understands it is enforced from the date he left the squad's training camp in Denmark on September 30. It means the 41-year-old former Manchester United and Real Madrid star is available to play in Portugal's Nations League matches next month against Denmark and Wales if he is called upon by Jesus. Ronaldo accused Jesus of broken promises and a "breach of trust" over his involvement in the team . The new head coach denied there had been any agreement. metadata.content: Cheavon Clarke vs Chris Billam-Smith: 'C4' set for all-British cruiserweight bout at Copper Box Arena | Boxing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Cheavon Clarke vs Chris Billam-Smith: 'C4' set for all-British cruiserweight bout at Copper Box Arena Cheavon Clarke and Chris Billam-Smith resume their rivalry in the professional ranks as the main event on Zuffa Boxing 12 at the Copper Box Arena on November 7, live on Sky Sports Monday 19 October 2026 20:04, UK Image: Chris Billam-Smith and Cheavon Clarke (right) face off ahead of their November 7 fight, live on Sky Sports Cheavon Clarke insists he does not care about the amateur fight that Chris Billam-Smith finds "hard to watch". Billam-Smith lost to Clarke in the final of the national elite amateur championships in 2016, a result which the Bournemouth fighter believes denied him a place in the Team GB boxing squad. The letter, which has been seen by Sky Sports News , was written on Monday by UEFA secretary general Theodore Theodoridis and sent to his FIFA counterpart Mattias Grafstrom. Sky Sports News has also obtained a copy of the full list of 42 questions which cover 12 topics, including 10 alleged conflicts of interest, across eight pages. messages.text: Sage under increasing pressure at Crystal Palace

metadata.summary: Crystal Palace have no immediate plans to change their manager - but Pierre Sage is under increasing pressure following their 5-0 thrashing at Brighton on Sunday.
metadata.content: Crystal Palace manager Pierre Sage under increasing pressure after 5-0 defeat to Brighton | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Crystal Palace manager Pierre Sage under increasing pressure after 5-0 defeat to Brighton Former Lyon and Lens boss Pierre Sage was appointed Crystal Palace manager after Oliver Glasner left in the summer; the 47-year-old has won four of his 10 games in charge in all competitions; Palace lost 5-0 to rivals Brighton on Sunday By Chris Reidy and James Savundra Monday 19 October 2026 18:23, UK Image: Crystal Palace manager Pierre Sage is under increasing pressure at Selhurst Park Crystal Palace have no immediate plans to change their manager - but Pierre Sage is under increasing pressure following their 5-0 thrashing at Brighton on Sunday. Palace find themselves 14th with seven points from seven games and Sage was unable to give assurances he had the club's full support after such a bitter defeat to their rivals. Chairman Steve Parish recently stated the club was on "high alert" during the transitionary process from the era of Oliver Glasner into the new one under Sage, which includes a number of new players and a first Europa League campaign.
